item: A7. FRA Naives-Rosières 12 MW vs Erize St Dizier 12 MW (2008)
proposal: (no rule yet) Not proven to be a duplicate: the register has two separate ~11.5 MW units, “Perfect Wind Erize” in Naives-Rosières (14 Aug 2008) and an unnamed one in Érize-Saint-Dizier (5 Mar 2009). If Naives-Rosières is the commune’s own park, fix year=2008 and keep both; if Erize St Dizier is the Perfect Wind Erize park, dup Naives-Rosières into it and give Erize St Dizier’s other unit a record.
note_zh: 登錄有兩個約 11.5 MW 的併網點：Naives-Rosières 的 Perfect Wind Erize（2008-08-14）與 Érize-Saint-Dizier 的一個（2009-03-05），兩筆紀錄可能分屬兩座。
note_en: The register has two ~11.5 MW units: Perfect Wind Erize in Naives-Rosières (14 Aug 2008) and one in Érize-Saint-Dizier (5 Mar 2009); the two records may be two farms.
why: Overpass (OpenStreetMap) timed out repeatedly for this area, and Géorisques has no wind ICPE within 5 km of Naives-Rosières except Rumont/Érize-la-Brûlée parks; which record is which park is still open.

item: A9b. FRA Entre Seine Et Aube 49 MW (2010) vs La Prévoterie 48.9 MW (2021, ENGIE) — side finding
farm: Entre Seine Et Aube wind farm; La Prévoterie wind farm
proposal: (no rule yet) The two records overlap: both have La Prévoterie’s 2010 phase (37 / 36.9 MW, 18 × MM92). Entre Seine Et Aube adds the 12 MW 2013 phase (register “MSE PREVOTERIE RHEGES” 12.3 MW, 1 Jan 2014); La Prévoterie adds the 2021 extension (Eolis Les Champs, 12 MW). A clean option: dup Entre Seine Et Aube into La Prévoterie and fix La Prévoterie to mw=61.2, ph=[[2010, 36.9], [2014, 12.3], [2021, 12]] (or leave Entre Seine Et Aube and cut La Prévoterie to the 12 MW 2021 extension). Needs a decision on which name to keep.
note_zh: Entre Seine Et Aube 與 La Prévoterie 兩筆都含 La Prévoterie 2010 年的 37 MW 一期。
note_en: Entre Seine Et Aube and La Prévoterie both contain La Prévoterie’s 37 MW 2010 phase.
why: Not in the brief; found while checking the Droupt records. The DREAL report counts 24 MM92 (= 49.2 MW: 18 of 2010 + 6 of Rhèges) for the original park, plus the separate 6 × 2 MW extension of 2021.

item: B1. FRA L'Huître Et Granville 24 MW — year
proposal: (ready either way) fix('FRA', "L'Huître Et Granville wind farm", G, '補上商轉年 2009／2010：…', '…', url, year=2009 or 2010). Capacity is now settled (24 MW = Grandville Énergies 12 MW + Dosnon Énergies 12 MW, both “formerly the Lhuître park”, Valemo); only the year remains: register and OSM 19 Dec 2009 vs Valorem’s brochure February 2010.
note_zh: 容量已確認：24 MW ＝ Grandville Énergies 12 ＋ Dosnon Énergies 12 MW（都是原 Lhuître 風場，Valemo）；年份：登錄 2009-12-19，Valorem 簡介 2010 年 2 月。
note_en: Capacity confirmed: 24 MW = Grandville Énergies 12 + Dosnon Énergies 12 MW (both formerly the Lhuître park, Valemo); year: register 19 Dec 2009, Valorem brochure February 2010.
why: The register’s datemiseenservice equals dateraccordement (19/12/2009) for both units, so it may record grid connection only; Valorem says “mis en service en février 2010” (and “10 éoliennes”, while DREAL counts 6 + 6). Recommendation: year=2010 if the developer’s commissioning date is preferred, 2009 if the register is the rule; the main session should pick one convention.

item: B7. FRA Mauléon 18.4 MW (EOS Holding, no year)
proposal: (no rule yet) The record is GEM’s approximate geocode of “Mauléon” in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques (43.23, −0.91), where no wind unit is registered; EOS’s park is most likely in Mauléon (Deux-Sèvres), which has two wind ICPEs (SAS Eole 79 at La Gralière; SEPE Delta Sèvre Argent) and two register units (8 MW 2008, 9 MW 2023). Neither sums to 18.4 MW and no EOS source names the park.
note_zh: 紀錄落在 Pyrénées-Atlantiques 的 Mauléon-Licharre（GEM 概略定位），當地無風電；EOS 的風場較可能在 Deux-Sèvres 省 Mauléon，但容量與年份都對不上。
note_en: The record sits at Mauléon-Licharre (GEM’s approximate point), where there is no wind power; EOS’s park is more likely in Mauléon (Deux-Sèvres), but neither capacity nor year matches yet.
why: eosholding.ch/en/eos-nre returns almost no text; the Eole 79 inspection report text has no capacity; searches found no EOS–Mauléon link. Still missing: a source naming EOS’s Mauléon park with capacity and date.
